one_liner: VS Code extension that writes conventional commit messages and PR descriptions from your staged diff, with a local-model option.
description: gitwhisper reads the staged diff in VS Code and drafts a commit message that follows Conventional Commits, plus an optional PR description summarizing the change set. Teams that cannot send code to cloud APIs can point it at a local Ollama model instead. It learns each repo's commit style from history.
target_user: Developers who commit many times a day and dislike writing commit messages

icp.who: IC developers on teams that enforce Conventional Commits or meaningful commit hygiene
icp.pain: Writing accurate commit messages is a chore, so history fills with 'fix' and 'wip' that make archaeology painful later
icp.buying_trigger: Team adopts Conventional Commits or commit-lint and message quality suddenly gets enforced in CI

differentiators: Local-model mode via Ollama for teams that cannot send diffs to cloud APIs
Learns per-repo commit style from the last 200 commits instead of using a generic template
Generates both the commit message and a PR description from the same diff analysis
proof_points: 18,000 installs on the VS Code Marketplace
Generates a message in under 2 seconds with a local 3B model
pricing_current: freemium ($4/month Pro unlocks PR descriptions and style learning)

voice.sample_phrase: Commit messages your future self will thank you for.

signals: Public Marketplace listing with regular releases
Paid tier live with Stripe checkout

gaps: No JetBrains version despite requests in reviews
Website is a single landing page with no docs

confidence.notes: Install counts and ratings are publicly visible on the Marketplace. Latency claim comes from the vendor's own demo.
